LBR.note: Document states nothing on a central bank role.
Document is about IMEI regulations, not digital financial services protection.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority was holding a two-day public consultation in Grand Bassa County with mobile phone owners and equipment users on its proposed IMEI Regulations.
LTA Commissioner Ben Fofana pointed to the interoperability of mobile money services between Orange Liberia and Lonestar Cell MTN as a significant step.

LBR.note: Document states nothing on revenue payment.

facts.fact: LTA Commissioner Ben Fofana said Starlink holds a one-year provisional licence which LTA plans to convert to a full operational licence in the coming months.
